prayerTree.title: Bishiyar Sallah mako-mako
prayerTree.subtitle: An kammala wannan makon: _VAR_0__/35 Addu'o'i
prayerTree.quote: Addu'a ita ce ginshiƙin imani; kowace addu'a da aka kammala tana samun ganye mai ban sha'awa ga itacen ku.
prayerTree.quoteHigh: "Addu'a itace ginshiƙin imani." - Kuna da mako na musamman, MashaAllah!
prayerTree.quoteMid: “Ku tsai da salla, ku ba da zakka, kuma ku yi ruku’u tare da masu ruku’i. (Al-Baqarah, aya ta 43).
prayerTree.quoteLow: "Lalle ne, an wajabta addu'a a kan muminai a kan wasu lokuta kayyade." (An-Nisa, aya ta 103).
